The original code directly parsed and evaluated user-provided expressions without any restrictions:

```java
return parser.parseExpression(expression).getValue();

T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec("rm -rf /")

- Blocks access to arbitrary Java classes via `T(...)`
- Blocks method execution on arbitrary objects
- Blocks constructor references
- Still supports basic math
